CustomObject.description: Configurable business settings for SmartProcurement: supplier scoring weights, scorecard risk thresholds, dispatch retry limits and the optional AI Named Credential. A single record named Default is read by ProcurementConfig.
CustomObject.label: Procurement Setting

fields.description: Relative weight of price when ranking supplier offers and scoring suppliers. Weights are normalised, so they do not need to add up to 100.
fields.label: Price Weight

fields.description: Relative weight of quality (offer quality rating, or 100 minus the defect rate on scorecards).
fields.label: Quality Weight

fields.description: Relative weight of delivery performance (offer delivery rating, or on-time rate on scorecards).
fields.label: Delivery Weight

fields.description: Relative weight of lead time (shorter quoted lead time on offers, lead-time adherence on scorecards). Zero disables it.
fields.label: Lead Time Weight

fields.description: A scorecard with an overall score below this value is rated High risk.
fields.label: High Risk Below Score

fields.description: A scorecard with an overall score below this value (and not High) is rated Medium risk.
fields.label: Medium Risk Below Score

fields.description: Number of days, ending today, evaluated by SupplierScorecardBatch.
fields.label: Scorecard Period (Days)

fields.description: Maximum number of external dispatch attempts per purchase order, including the first attempt.
fields.label: Max Dispatch Attempts

fields.description: Delay before the first retry. It doubles on every further retry and is capped at 10 minutes (Queueable delay limit).
fields.label: Retry Delay (Minutes)

fields.description: Developer name of the Named Credential for the AI service used by ProcurementAIService. Leave blank until an AI integration is configured.
fields.label: AI Named Credential
